fields.description: Days after the delivery date this visit's window opens (delivery day itself = 0).
fields.label: Window Opens (Day)

fields.description: Days after the delivery date this visit's window closes. After this, the visit counts as overdue.
fields.label: Window Closes (Day)

fields.description: High Risk only: how many days into THIS window (from Window Opens) the CHW should be nudged to visit early. Only affects the red alert shown during a normal window - unrelated to the urgent visit below.
fields.label: Risk Alert Within (Days)

fields.description: If THIS visit is completed with Patient Condition = Risk, an extra urgent follow-up is scheduled this many days after the visit's own date. Independent of Risk Alert Within Days above - each visit row sets its own urgent timing.
fields.label: Urgent Visit Within (Days)
